rows.ARS:
Medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: HARportly
Exhibition name: Neville Gibson
rows.Origin:
Bred by Harkness & Co. (United Kingdom, before 1980).
Introduced in United Kingdom by R Harkness & Co. Ltd. in 1982 as 'Neville Gibson'.
rows.Bloom: Pink. Mild fragrance. 40 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very full (41+ petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Medium, upright. Large, semi-glossy, medium green foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
